findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_user_session, get_league_info, get_draft, get_standings, get_matchups, get_roster, get_free_agents, get_players, get_transactions · Private data: get_standings, get_matchups, get_roster, get_players · Public sink: refresh_leagues · Destructive: refresh_leagues, get_ancient_history, get_league_info, get_matchups, get_free_agents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_user_session, get_league_info, get_draft, get_standings, get_matchups, get_roster, get_free_agents, get_players, get_transactions · Private data: get_standings, get_matchups, get_roster, get_players · Public sink: refresh_leagues · Destructive: refresh_leagues, get_ancient_history, get_league_info, get_matchups, get_free_agents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
